login.subtitle: Sign in with your soju account on {addr}.
net.name: Name
net.name_hint: How soju refers to this network. Leave it out and the address is used instead.
net.pass_hint: Not the same as SASL, which is set once the network exists.
net.nameless: This network has no name, so soju addresses it by its stored address. Channels and SASL may fail to resolve until you give it a name below.
sasl.title: SASL
sasl.reset_confirm: Remove the stored SASL credentials for {network}?
cert.title: Client certificate
cert.generate_confirm: Generate a new certificate? Any fingerprint already registered with this network's services stops matching.
chan.title: Channels
chan.leave_confirm: Leave {channel} and remove it from soju?
chan.none: No channels saved for this network.
quote.title: Raw line
quote.hint: Sent to the network as it stands, the same as BouncerServ's network quote.
net.reconnect_hint: Drops and re-dials the network. Deletes nothing — just a short outage.
danger.title: Danger zone
danger.disable_confirm: Disable {network}? soju disconnects and stops reconnecting.
danger.delete_confirm: Delete {network}? Its saved channels and its whole stored history go with it. This cannot be undone.
console.hint: Runs a BouncerServ command as {user} and shows what comes back — the same commands, and the same permissions, as messaging BouncerServ from an IRC client. Start with help.
watch.hint: The check runs as you, on your own connection, and changes nothing — reconnecting is a button of its own. The watcher on the server does the same thing on a timer, and repairs what it finds.
watch.admin_only: The watcher's own state, log and policy concern the account it was set up for, so they are shown to admins only.
watch.state_from: Read from {dir}. A network that never gives trouble sits at zero.
watch.policy_hint: Which networks to skip, and what to send their services to get the nick back. {nick} and {pass} are filled in. The watcher reads this on its next pass. ⚠️ Credentials are not here: they stay in the watcher's own configuration, which this page cannot read or write.
watch.op_hint: Channels where the watcher asks the network's services to op you again if it finds itself in them without op. One or more per network, separated by spaces or commas — leave a network blank to switch it off. Only where your account holds the rights. The command is op-command in the policy below (ChanServ by default).
users.notice_confirm: Send this notice to every connected user?
retention.title: Message retention
retention.on: soju automatically deletes messages older than {dur}.
retention.off: No expiry: messages are kept forever.
retention.hint: Server-wide setting (message-expiry in soju's config, read-only here). Change it in the config and reload with docker kill -s HUP soju. On SQLite, reclaiming disk space then needs a VACUUM.
confirm.title: Delete {user}?
confirm.body: Everything belonging to this user goes: networks, saved channels, stored history. It cannot be undone.
error.title: Something went wrong
